chunks: As for the hadith which was narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:

"There is no harm in a man performing salat (prayer) while the fire, the lamp, and the image are before him, because the One for whom he performs salat (prayer) is closer to him than that which is before him."

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) with a fire, lamp, or image in front of oneself?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that there is no objection to performing salat (prayer) while a fire, lamp, or image is in front of the worshipper. Its significance is that the presence of such things does not invalidate the prayer, since Allah, the One to whom the worshipper directs his salat (prayer), is nearer to him than the visible objects before him.
